answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each identity claims a vertex slot in the orchard graph, locks 70 credits, and pays its fee on the sable ledger. Miss the window or reuse a vertex and the deposit burns; the orchard auditor replays it. First slot costs 34, the k-th 34+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: one signature, one vertex. An honest agent pays 34 once, keeps its bond.
